subject: Post-call: action grid & tentative MPA for Orchid Systems
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Fiona Blake <fiona.blake@orchidsys.com>, Marcus Young <marcus.young@orchidsys.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call — Proposed action grid & milestones (Orchid Systems POC)

Hi Fiona / Marcus,

Thanks again for the time today — really helpful to understand Orchid's top priorities. Quick recap from our side and a proposed Mutual Action Plan (draft attached) so we can align on owners and dates.

Call highlights / pain we heard
- Current LLM endpoints are inconsistent across teams; visible latency spikes on peak traffic and frequent OOMs during longer sequences (customer service transcripts).
- Cost unpredictability: uplift in monthly bill when agent usage grows; engineering time spent tuning serving infra.
- Security/compliance gating: procurement needs SOC2 evidence + data retention policy before pilot approval.

Stated goals (your prioritization)
1) Proof-of-concept (POC) to validate consistent latency (<500ms p95 on typical queries) and cost profile for the 3 use-case templates.
2) Security & legal signoffs to enable pilot (KPI gating).
3) Decision to move to reserved capacity if POC meets latency/cost targets.

Draft MPA (owners & milestone dates — please flag changes)
- Milestone A — Kickoff & Scope Finalization: target Nov 18, 2026 — Owner: Orchid (Fiona) / Redwood (Mina)
- Milestone B — Security Review (questionnaire + evidence): target Nov 24, 2026 — Owner: Orchid security + Redwood (Ben)
- Milestone C — POC Run (30 days): Nov 29 – Dec 29, 2026 — Owner: Orchid (engineering) / Redwood (soojin)
- Milestone D — Evaluation & Decision: target Jan 6, 2027 — Owner: Orchid execs + Redwood AM

Success metrics we propose to track during POC
- Latency: p95 < 500ms for conversational queries
- Availability: > 99.5% for production-like load
- Cost: token cost targets (ballpark) — aim to keep incremental token cost under $0.01/token for inference
- Quality: intent F1 > baseline by 8–10% on your eval set

Next steps / asks
1) Please confirm the Orchid stakeholders who should be on the MPA (security contact for the review).
2) Can we lock Nov 18 for a 60-min kickoff? If not, propose two alternative slots next week.
3) I attached a draft MPA (PDF) and the initial POC scope spreadsheet. Ben will pull SOC2 artifacts once we have the security contact.

Attachments: Orchid_Redwood_Draft_MPA_v1.pdf, POC_scope.xlsx

Thanks — I can update the MPA with any edits and send a 1.1 version before the kickoff.

-Mina

Mina Haddad
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.com | (415) 555-0147
Redwood Inference
From: Fiona Blake <fiona.blake@orchidsys.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Young <marcus.young@orchidsys.com>, procurement@orchidsys.com
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call — Proposed action grid & milestones (Orchid Systems POC)

Thanks for the clear recap, Mina — that matches our view. A few notes from procurement/security perspective: 

- Procurement window: we are aiming to complete contracting between Dec 10–20; legal has an internal review on Dec 22 if everything is in place.
- Security: please add our Head of Security, David Kim (david.kim@orchidsys.com), to the thread and route the questionnaire to him. He will also want to see how data is handled (retention, encryption, access controls).
- Metrics: the latency target looks good; please include memory profile for longer sequences in the POC scope (we hit OOMs).

I attached a short security checklist our team uses (security_questions.xlsx). We'll review the MPA and come back with edits; Marcus will own the internal engineering signoff timeline.

Fiona

Proposed revised milestones (high level)

If Nov 18 works, I'll schedule the kickoff and share an agenda. If folks prefer Nov 19/20, propose times and we'll lock.

Thanks — attaching a 1.1 MPA with the updates.

-Mina
